title: Move Peer AI from next.16 to next.18
goal: next.17 and next.18 landed within minutes of next.16 being adopted here, and both fix friction this project hit today: a merged item's done record stayed uncommitted on a branch that no longer existed, run_verify re-ran against a records-only push, and the gate went red on a draft that could not merge. next.17 also has next_work read CI's checks itself. Adopt both, read what render writes before committing it, and keep ci:watch and ci:premerge, which gate any base branch rather than only main.
acceptance: Given the config, package files and workflows, when the move is done, then every reference to a Peer AI version names 1.0.0-next.18 and none names next.16

Given render writes new workflows, when they are reviewed, then anything the project does not need — such as a scan for a server this product does not have — is identified and decided rather than committed unread
Given peer-ai doctor and peer-ai check, when they run on next.18, then both pass with no new problem
Given the project's own ci:watch and ci:premerge scripts, when next.17's CI reading arrives, then the scripts stay, because Peer AI's gate guards main while ci:premerge guards any base branch
next: Read what this item needs, then plan it.
